comments.note: now() in this codebase returns second-precision ISO strings, so Date.now() (millisecond precision) can exceed the truncated timestamp. New tests account for this by flooring 'before' with Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) * 1000. This is a pattern worth documenting or standardising in a test helper to avoid the same trap in future timestamp-sensitive assertions.

A comment explaining the tolerance would improve intent clarity. Non-blocking.
